expectations.text: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
expectations.evidence: Three candidates: 'A. (OKF doesn't matter any more) "One fact per file was a retrieval workaround..."', 'B. (it still matters, just somewhere else) "Better recall didn't make the discipline obsolete. It moved it."', 'C. (genuinely undecided...) "I built a storage layer to enforce a format..."'

expectations.text: Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
expectations.evidence: Who 'practitioners running a memory layer for coding agents... including readers of posts 1 and 2'; Believes now 'that structured, atomic facts (OKF or similar) are what makes agent memory trustworthy'; Should leave with 'a clear view of what a good recall engine does and doesn't replace in a hand-built memory discipline'
Tension: 'Either the discipline was never what made memory useful, or its cost hasn't arrived yet... The reader can't tell which, and neither, for now, can the author.'

expectations.text: Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
expectations.evidence: Recommended Build log + before/after as a 9-row numbered beat table; 'Alternative arc: Three attempts' beats 1-6 and 'Alternative arc: Governing analogy, extended' beats 1-6. Reason: 'The build log is the series' established follow-up shape. Post 2 used it... The before/after graft is there because "recall is better" is a comparative claim and needs to be shown'

expectations.text: Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
expectations.evidence: 'Beat 4: the reader should see the same question answered twice'; 'Beat 6: the reader should see an OKF fact next to its Hindsight equivalent'; 'Beat 3: The reader sees post 1's three tiers with only the Common Law box swapped out'

expectations.text: Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
expectations.evidence: Honesty beats: 'Post 2 defended OKF. If it doesn't matter, say so plainly'; '"Not sure yet" is itself an honesty beat. One month may be too short'; 'Post 2's unresolved items... Report each honestly, including the ones that didn't move'

expectations.text: Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
expectations.evidence: Beats 2 and 4-9 'author to supply', beat 3 'to confirm' ('presumably untouched'); analogy flagged 'This is my suggestion, not Matt's claim' and Hindsight mechanism 'to confirm. I don't know its internals beyond what post 2 states'. Quoted and cited material verified in published posts: 'I am still a fan of OKF as a format...' (post 2 l.84), 'A fact you can search, supersede and scope individually is a fact you can trust' (l.31), Retain/Recall/Reflect and tagged at ingest (l.90), 'several years ahead' (l.88), stale/superseded/duplicate consolidation (l.80), Claude's own memory (l.82), the three scripts, v1.2.0, post 1 'key changes... post 3' (l.135). Only slip: 'I am very keen to actually use Hindsight' drops 'also' from the original, not an invented fact
